post.description: Creates a new merchant profile in the system. Use this endpoint to onboard a merchant by providing the required business details. On success, the merchant record is created and the registration information is returned.

Submits merchant verification information for validation. Use this endpoint to provide verification details required for merchant onboarding or compliance checks. On success, the verification request is processed and the verification result is returned.

get.description: Retrieves the available merchant verification catalogues and requirements. Use this endpoint to obtain the list of supported verification types and categories before submitting verification requests.

post.description: Creates a new merchant user account. Use this endpoint to register a merchant user by providing personal and login details. On success, the user account is created and ready for verification.

get.description: Verifies a merchant user account using the verification token and email address provided during registration. Use this endpoint to activate a newly registered account. Supply the token and email as query parameters before making the request.

post.description: Authenticates a merchant user and grants access to protected resources. Use this endpoint to log in with valid credentials. On success, the system returns authentication details and access credentials.

Initiates the password recovery process for a merchant user account. Use this endpoint to request a password reset by providing the registered email address. On success, password reset instructions are sent to the user.

get.description: Validates a password reset token before allowing a password change. Use this endpoint to confirm that the reset token is valid and has not expired. Supply the token as a query parameter before making the request.

post.description: Resets the password for a merchant user account. Use this endpoint to create a new password after successful token verification. On success, the account password is updated.

Generates a new access token using a valid refresh token. Use this endpoint to maintain an authenticated session without requiring the user to log in again. On success, a new access token is returned.

get.description: Retrieves the profile information of the authenticated merchant. Use this endpoint to view the merchant's account details, business information, and profile settings.

Retrieves a paginated list of permissions available in the system. Use this endpoint to view existing permissions and their associated details. Pagination parameters can be supplied to control the results returned.

post.description: Creates a new permission within the system. Use this endpoint to define a new permission that can be assigned to roles and users. On success, the permission is created and returned.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific permission using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to view information about a particular permission. Replace {permissionUuid} with the actual permission identifier before making the request.

put.description: Updates an existing permission. Use this endpoint to modify permission details such as its name or description. Replace {permissionUuid} with the actual permission identifier before making the request.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of roles available in the system. Use this endpoint to view all configured roles and their details. Pagination parameters can be supplied to control the results returned.

post.description: Creates a new role within the system. Use this endpoint to define a role that can be assigned to users and associated with permissions. On success, the role is created and returned.

Each item corresponds to a LoanCustomPropertyType property. Expected values: NetPay

 Enter 'Bearer' [space] and then your token in the text input below.

Example: "Bearer 12345abcdef"
